notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p4); it lists spending by object only, so object lines take general government with review (capital outlay and debt service by their own categories). Beginning cash = beginning fund balance (restated) 428,509 (p4; all assets are cash/CDs, no liabilities); ending 116,633 (p3) includes CDs 399,530 (ending_investments, informational). Gains on sale of assets 26,300 in other_financing. The report's own rounding leaves the governmental roll-forward 1 off (see report_discrepancies). Business-type from the proprietary statement (p6, measure net position; Water, Sewer, Garbage, Keno columns), totals = operating + nonoperating. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1, Total column) because it includes capital assets and debt. The only supplementary schedule is the all-funds budget statement (pp7-8), so detail is per fund column of the governmental and proprietary fund statements (no revenue total printed per proprietary fund beyond the charges line). Read pages 1-8 of 8
